category_title: Preschoolers who cry when encountering perceived difficult tasks
scenario_title: Getting dressed during school routines with visual prompts
minimal_context: Zeke is getting ready for recess and needs to put on his coat in Mr. Cho's class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Zeke, it is time for recess. Please put on your coat.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the coat and begins to whine) It's too hard.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Struggles with the sleeve and starts crying softly)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep working on it, you need your coat to go outside.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drops the coat and cries loudly, with the crying episode lasting for over 77 seconds)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Zeke, it is time for recess. Please put on your coat.

STUDENT: (Looks at the coat and begins to whine) It's too hard.

TUTOR: Just give it a try.

STUDENT: (Struggles with the sleeve and starts crying softly)

TUTOR: Keep working on it, you need your coat to go outside.

STUDENT: (Drops the coat and cries loudly, with the crying episode lasting for over 77 seconds)

task.content: getting dressed or undressed (e.g., putting or taking off his coat)
task.learning_goal: attempt the task or ask for help without crying

context.environment: arrival routine, before recess, and dismissal routine
context.materials: visual prompt mounted above his coat hook that includes pictures of the steps for putting on/taking off his clothes, preferred sticker for his sticker chart
context.time_context: arrival routine, before recess, and dismissal routine

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When Zeke perceives a task to be too difficult
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Zeke whines, cries softly or cries loudly
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: perceives a task to be too difficult
related_quotes: When Zeke perceives a task to be too difficult (e.g., getting dressed, fine motor tasks), Zeke whines, cries softly or cries loudly.

behavior_patterns.condition: during arrival routine, before recess, and dismissal routine
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: crying episodes are lasting 77 seconds or longer with five or more episodes per day
related_quotes: On average his crying episodes are lasting 77 seconds or longer with five or more episodes per day.
